title: FILIPINO FOOD CHALLENGE - PANCIT feat. Erwan, Becoming Filipino and the Juicy Vlog
description:
We met up with Erwan Heussaff and Kulas aka Kyle Jennerman aka Becoming Filipino and the Juicy Vlog for a filipino food challenge. The Juicy vlog and we cooked Filipino Pancit after Erwan taught us how to make Pancit in his Studio. Kulas judged who made the better Pancit - watch this video to find out who won the challenge :)

Thanks Erwan for having us! Check out Erwan Heussaff's Youtube channel and subscribe:
